goal: Make the Danyel OZ catalogue sync-ready: public per-song sync fields and a shared licensing settings tab edited in the admin app, a catalogue widget, a printable one-sheet, paste-ready contact copy, and handbook updates, all tested locally with nothing pushed or published.
strategy: Two foundations first, in parallel: the server data layer (Sync.gs, columns and sync_settings tab per D-1/D-5) and a shared widget core (danyeloz-embeds/sync-core.js: CSV parse, header guards, lists, link allowlist, rights line, one-sheet selection) with shared mocked CSV fixtures. The core is where the riskiest rules live (Sheet1 trap, D-6 mailto exception, PRO-blank wording), so it is tested before any page is built. Wave 2 builds the admin UI on Sync.gs and the two widgets plus contact copy on the core. Wave 3 updates handbooks once names are final. Wave 4 is independent QA with its own planted data.

tasks.title: Write apps-script/Sync.gs data layer with its Node unit test
definition_of_done: Sync.gs defines SY_TRACK_COLUMNS (D-1 names), SY_SETTINGS_TAB = sync_settings, SY_SETTING_COLUMNS (D-5), SY_MOODS (20), SY_GENRES (12), SY_VOCALS (4), SY_KEYS (24), SY_MAX_FEATURED = 10, SY_DEFAULTS; no name collides with other .gs files.

getSyncAdmin() returns per-ISRC sync fields, readiness {complete, total, missing[{isrc,title,fields}]} per D-4, settings (defaults when tab missing), lists, and studio-note bpm/key hints; it performs zero sheet writes.
saveTrackSync(isrc, d) under lock_(): adds missing sync columns by header via trPublicTab_, writes via trPutRow_ (text through safeText_, flags as text TRUE or empty), never touches other columns.

saveTrackSync rejects: BPM not a whole number 40-220 (blank allowed), key/genre/vocal not in list, a mood not in list or more than 3, writers/producers over 200 chars, an 11th featured song across the tab.

saveSyncSettings(d) under lock_() writes one row of sync_settings (creates tab on first save); contact_email must match an email pattern; contact_url blank or https; all values via safeText_; sets updated.

tests/unit/test_sync.js loads Code, Shorts, Singles, Tracks, Sync; covers append-after-abc with existing cells unchanged, each rejection above, featured cap, settings round trip, formula-prefix escaping, PASSED line.
